checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames are 496x826 portrait with artwork filling the frame and no bars. Ratio is about 0.60, close to 9:16. Duration is stated as 8 s.

must.item: Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons move slowly on dark background
must.why: Blue and purple translucent ribbons glow on near-black. They change shape clearly between frames. They rise into an arch at 3.2 s, so the motion is fairly large for 'slow'.

must.item: Top third stays mostly dark, brightest ribbons lower down
must.why: The top third is dark in every sampled frame. At 3.2 s the ribbon arch rises to about 39% of the height, with a faint glow reaching the top-third boundary. Mid-clip the brightest ribbons sit mid-frame, not low.

must.item: No visible jump or flash at the loop boundary
must.why: Frame 7.6 s is very similar to the start frame at 0.8 s and the still. The same first and last frame was used. I could not check the actual seam.

must.item: No words, clock graphics or interface elements
must.why: No text or UI is visible in any frame.
Audio cannot be judged from stills. The assistant says the video has no sound.

faults.what: At about 3.2 s the ribbons swing up into a large arch in the middle of the frame. This is more motion than 'slow' suggests and brings bright ribbons near the clock area.
The 480p output is soft, with slight compression noise in the dark areas.

summary: A clean portrait video of glowing blue and purple ribbons on black, with a dark top third and an apparently seamless loop; the ribbons arch up to mid-frame at around 3 s, which is more motion than 'slow' implies.
